ávya, a. pertaining to sheep, woolen;
 🞄n. Soma-strainer.

āvyâ, a. (āvī) relating to sheep;
 woollen.
ā-vyakta, pp. perfectly clear.
a-vyagra, a. unconcerned, quiet: -m, 🞄ad. -ly.
a-vyaṅga, a. having all oneʼs limbs.

a-vyañjana, a. beardless;
 lacking 🞄signs of puberty.
a-vi‿ati-rikta, pp. not separated 🞄from.
ā-vyathā́, f. slight emotion: -ṃ kṛ. 🞄be somewhat touched.
a-vyavasāyin, a. unenterprising, 🞄remiss.

a-vyava-stha, a. not enduring: ā, 🞄f. unsettled state;
 -sthita-citta, a. fickleminded.
a-vyasanin, a. exempt from vice.
á-vi‿ā-kṛta, pp. unsevered, undivided.

a-vyāja, m. not deception;
 a. natural, 🞄real.
a-vi‿ā-panna, pp. not having died, 🞄alive.
a-vyāpāra, m. not oneʼs business.
a-vi‿āpta, pp. not filled or mixed 🞄with.
a-vi‿āvart-anīya, fp. not to be 🞄taken back.

a-vyāhṛta, (pp.) n. not speaking;
 🞄silence.
a-vi‿uc-chinna, pp. uninterrupted.

a-vi‿utpanna, pp. not resulting;
 🞄having no etymology: -mati, a. uneducated.
á-vi‿uṣṭa, pp. (√ vas) not yet arisen.
a-vyākṣepa, m. absence of distraction, 🞄presence of mind.
